svg.text: Wiring: torso, expander, radar, neck, ambient sensors
3.3 V except radar and neck (5 V) · numbers = header pins
Polarized magnets: a reversed head is repelled.
Flashing over the head's USB: off the neck.
DOCK → PCF8574 P1 (low = head in place)
Ambient sensors: same I2C bus as the PCF8574, in parallel
Same four wires as the PCF8574:
Easiest: start from the PCF8574 cascade output
(female header at the far end of the module),
then “capteurs”: the light reading follows your hand.
3.3 V on the I2C bus, the PCF8574 and the sensors · 5 V only on the radar and the neck (pin 2)
PCF8574: SCL → 26 · SDA → 28 · VCC → 31/32 (3V3) · GND → 4, 29 or 30 · radar OUT → P0 · DOCK → P1
BME280 and BH1750: the same four wires as the PCF8574, in parallel (module cascade output, then splice) · BH1750 ADDR to ground
Radar: 5 V → pin 2 · GND → pin 4 · OUT → P0 · Neck: +5 V → 2 · T→H ← TX 27 · H→T → RX 25 · GND → 29
Camera, TF card, audio and USB GPIOs are reserved: connect nothing to them. Tests: “scan”, “radar”, “capteurs”.
